text: Understanding databases is essential for managing information effectively. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store data in tables with rows and columns, which makes them ideal for structured information. NoSQL databases are more flexible and work well with unstructured data. To retrieve information, you use queries, which are special commands that ask the database questions. Data modeling helps you plan how data is organized and connected before you build anything. Finally, indexes speed up searches, just like an index in a book. Together, these concepts form the foundation of working with databases.
